parameters.question: The dataset under analysis pertains to a non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) context, as indicated by the file path. CD4+ T cells.rationale: CD4 and CD3E are canonical markers for T cells, while IL2 and IL7R are associated with T cell activation. CD8A and CD19 are negative markers to exclude CD8+ T cells and B cells.

CD8+ T cells.rationale: CD8A and CD3E are canonical markers for T cells, while GZMB and PRF1 are associated with cytotoxic activity. CD4 and CD19 are negative markers to exclude CD4+ T cells and B cells.

Regulatory T cells.rationale: FOXP3, CD4, and CD25 are canonical markers for regulatory T cells, while CTLA4 is associated with immune suppression. CD8A and CD19 are negative markers to exclude CD8+ T cells and B cells.

B cells.rationale: CD19, CD79A, and MS4A1 are canonical markers for B cells, while IGHD is associated with B cell receptor diversity. CD3E and CD8A are negative markers to exclude T cells.

Plasma cells.rationale: CD138 and XBP1 are canonical markers for plasma cells, while IGHG1 and IGHA1 are associated with antibody secretion. CD19 and CD3E are negative markers to exclude B cells and T cells.

NK cells.rationale: NCAM1 and KLRD1 are canonical markers for NK cells, while GZMB and PRF1 are associated with cytotoxic activity. CD3E and CD19 are negative markers to exclude T cells and B cells.

Monocytes/macrophages.rationale: CD14 and CD68 are canonical markers for monocytes/macrophages, while LYZ and HLA-DRA are associated with phagocytosis and antigen presentation. CD3E and CD19 are negative markers to exclude T cells and B cells.

Dendritic cells.rationale: CD11C and CD86 are canonical markers for dendritic cells, while HLA-DRA and CCR7 are associated with antigen presentation and migration. CD3E and CD19 are negative markers to exclude T cells and B cells.

Endothelial cells.rationale: PECAM1, CDH5, VEGFR2, and VWF are canonical markers for endothelial cells. CD45 and EPCAM are negative markers to exclude hematopoietic and epithelial cells.

Fibroblasts / CAFs.rationale: ACTA2, COL1A1, FAP, and PDGFRB are canonical markers for fibroblasts and cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs). CD45 and EPCAM are negative markers to exclude hematopoietic and epithelial cells.

Pericytes.rationale: PDGFRB, RGS5, NG2, and CD146 are canonical markers for pericytes. CD45 and EPCAM are negative markers to exclude hematopoietic and epithelial cells.

Mast cells.rationale: KIT, FCER1A, CPA3, and TPSAB1 are canonical markers for mast cells. CD3E and CD19 are negative markers to exclude T cells and B cells.
